sources.snippet: Abstract In this report, we introduce Qwen3-ASR family, which includes two powerful all-in-one speech recognition models and a novel non-autoregressive speech forced alignment model. Qwen3-ASR-1.7B and Qwen3-ASR-.6B are ASR models that support language identification and ASR for 52 languages and dialects.
